record.title: CFTC swap reporting counterparty or registered-entity route
record.sub: Report trades and retain regulatory records
kv: CEA swap-data framework and 17 CFR Parts 45 and 49.
The transaction is a CFTC-regulated swap and Part 45 assigns a reporting counterparty or reporting task to a SEF, DCM, or DCO.

swap dealer; major swap participant; other reporting counterparty as allocated by Part 45; swap execution facility; designated contract market; derivatives clearing organization; third-party reporting facilitator acting for the responsible reporter

Classify the instrument as a CFTC-regulated swap and identify the reporting hierarchy or registered-entity rule. Select an appropriate SDR and meet its data, validation, timing, and access requirements. A counterparty may contract with a facilitator to submit data, but preserve the assigned reporting party's responsibility and evidence of successful acceptance.

A delegate submits or facilitates only under the responsible party's arrangement; it is neither automatically the reporting counterparty nor an SDR. A generic blockchain log or oracle feed is not an SDR report.

sources.label: CFTC final Part 45 rulemaking: third-party reporting facilitation
